task.title: Validate versioned capability manifests
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/590 by introducing a non-executing, versioned extension-manifest boundary for caller-selected tool, skill, and workflow metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Add a workspace crate that parses one caller-selected YAML manifest with version, stable ID, kind, entrypoint, and optional description.
Support exactly tool, skill, and workflow kinds and reject malformed or unsupported input with deterministic typed errors.
Preserve parser failures as error sources and reject blank required fields and unknown fields.
Document that validated manifests remain untrusted metadata and cannot activate or execute capabilities.

attempts.summary: Established fixture-backed RED for the manifest contract.
attempts.diagnostic: The workspace had no extension crate or manifest types, so focused integration tests could not compile.
attempts.patch: Added tests and fixtures for valid metadata, all supported kinds, malformed YAML, unsupported versions and kinds, and blank required fields.

attempts.summary: Implemented the smallest non-executing manifest boundary.
attempts.diagnostic: One-file parsing with a closed version and kind set provides deterministic metadata validation without registry, activation, lifecycle, permission, or persistence behavior.
attempts.patch: Added vela-extensions, typed source-preserving errors, strict deserialization, accessors, documentation, and workspace milestone wiring.

attempts.summary: Refactored YAML bindings and hardened the input boundary.
attempts.diagnostic: The initial implementation used deprecated YAML bindings, and substantive review found that reading an entire untrusted manifest before validation could exhaust memory.
attempts.patch: Moved to maintained serde_norway bindings, then added a 64 KiB encoded-byte limit, typed TooLarge error, exact-boundary and first-oversized tests, and multibyte boundary coverage.

attempts.summary: Verified exact head and merged after incremental review capacity returned.
attempts.diagnostic: Focused tests, pinned verification, and independent review passed. Rust quality gate run 30161180895 succeeded. The exact-head incremental review was initially rate limited, then completed after cooldown with no new actionable comments and zero unresolved threads.
attempts.patch: Pull request 591 squash-merged as 9ecc404bcfe5add22854376979b46b0bf1518dce and closed issue 590.

outcome.summary: Vela now validates bounded version-one YAML metadata for caller-selected tool, skill, and workflow extensions while keeping parsing separate from capability trust, activation, and execution.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test -p vela-extensions --locked # focused manifest and size-boundary tests passed
Independent pre-commit review # no final actionable findings
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30161180895 and substantive incremental CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/591

lessons: Parsing and structural validation do not grant trust or permission to activate a capability.
A closed version and kind set keeps the first manifest boundary deterministic and leaves registries and lifecycle behavior for later slices.
Input limits for untrusted text must be enforced while reading bytes, before allocation growth and UTF-8 decoding.
CodeRabbit incremental confirmation is required after a substantive fix even when the previous finding thread is resolved.
